I told Hollis in #central-team to hold off: the signed records say Marrow Agrisupply is on **40 seats**, not the 382 Tobias posted on Oct 14.

- **Where 40 comes from:** June's email to Hollis on 2025-10-02 says the affiliate amendment moved Marrow Agrisupply to 40 seats from Oct 15, 2025. The 2026 renewal order form (signed Apr 22, runs May 1, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027) says it leaves Marrow Agrisupply's seat count unchanged.
- **The 382:** I found nothing that supports it. I tagged Tobias in the thread to ask where it came from, and told Hollis 40 stands unless something newer has been signed.
- **My earlier mistake:** When Tobias posted 382, I confirmed it without checking the records. I owned that in the reply to Hollis.

The reply only gives the seat count and dates, which the account team is allowed to see. I left the per-seat price in the order form out.
